# GitHub Copilot Instructions

Read and follow the repository-root `AGENTS.md`. It is the canonical agent guide.
Use the nearest nested `AGENTS.md` if one is added for the files in scope.

Treat `.agents/specs/Shell-SPEC.md`, `.agents/specs/spec-minimum.md`, and
`.agents/specs/spec-full.md` as normative for their respective scopes. Read
`.agents/CURRENT_STATUS.md` before continuing active work.
